## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
CAUTION. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: only 2/11 sectors positive and pronounced weakness in Financials and Communication (BAC, GS, NFLX, TMUS BELOW TREND) while pockets of Tech/Healthcare sit ABOVE TREND, creating mixed signals; Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Healthcare leads: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY. Technology next: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND; Energy shows top-stock strength (MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND) despite a weak sector tape.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Communication is weakest: NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND. Financials are soft with BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND and GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND; Utilities and Industrials also showing notable downside.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY — Leadership: Moderate (3 sectors in Top 5: Tech, Healthcare, Energy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -7.76% | 1M: -7.24%) BELOW TREND, BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Communication and Financials.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Strongest 1W movers: PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +1.06%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND; note MAJOR DIVERGENCE: MSFT (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +2.15%) CORRECTION, TSLA (1W: -0.32% | 1M: +3.75%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: +3.34% | 1M: -9.95%) RECOVERY — tactical moves, not broad confirmation.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed but internally mixed-to-narrow: AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +1.82% | 1M: +2.28%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.37% | 1M: +2.15%) CORRECTION — Tech breadth: est. 10/24 positive; sector showing leadership concentration rather than broad participation.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Broad weakness: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, GS (1W: -8.47% | 1M: -7.34%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -1.84% | 1M: -2.12%) BELOW TREND — Financials breadth: est. 3/20 positive and acting as a headwind for risk appetite.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Relative strength but mixed internals: TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +5.83% | 1M: +0.15%) ABOVE TREND, ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY, LLY (1W: +3.34% | 1M: -9.95%) RECOVERY — Healthcare breadth: est. 12/17 positive and a key source of market support.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor selective exposure to Healthcare and high-quality Tech names showing ABOVE TREND while reducing exposure to weak Financials and Communication names; monitor energy names (MPC, VLO, PSX) for commodity-driven continuation. Style: mixed / no clear leadership given MAJOR DIVERGENCE and CAUTION regime.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: AMD (1W: +8.46% | 1M: +20.02%) ABOVE TREND, TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +7.31% | 1M: +17.78%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, BA (1W: -5.82% | 1M: -10.80%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Healthcare (1W: +1.98% | 1M: -4.67%) — breadth est. 12/17 positive. BEARISH: Communication (1W: -5.35% | 1M: -6.95%) and Financials (1W: -2.93% | 1M: -3.80%) — both showing concentrated downside.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Watch AMD near recent swing highs as confirmation for continuation (ABOVE TREND), AAPL support around current levels (AAPL (1W: +1.16% | 1M: +6.09%) ABOVE TREND) for leadership hold, BAC downside momentum — a further break would deepen Financials' drag.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
MDT (+80): FDA clearance headline; MDT (1W: +? | 1M: +?) — price action not in dataset for MDT but sector confirmation via strong Healthcare tape; ISRG (+75): EU nod — ISRG (1W: +6.55% | 1M: -1.10%) RECOVERY, TMO (+55): strong demand — TMO (1W: +6.91% | 1M: +6.26%) ABOVE TREND and confirming sentiment.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
BAC (-85): bond-loss headline and downside confirmed — BAC (1W: -7.91% | 1M: -8.15%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (-60): downgrade and price confirmed — NFLX (1W: -7.25% | 1M: -10.51%) BELOW TREND, CVS (-50): bankruptcy liquidation in division and price weakness confirmed — CVS (1W: -6.15% | 1M: -5.14%) BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership given weak breadth and internal divergences. Healthcare and select Tech names are showing strength (TMO ABOVE TREND, AMD ABOVE TREND, PANW ABOVE TREND). Key risk: Financials and Communication are weak (BAC, GS, NFLX BELOW TREND) and multiple large-cap names show 1W/1M divergences, so monitor sentiment-driven flow for confirmation.
